assumptions_and_qualifications: Protocol version 86 and max_inflation_rate 1/40 are verified at the nine anchor epochs and all 23 control-week epochs; the other earned epochs are not individually checked. Version selection is a stake vote, not a proof of monotonicity.
Semantics are read from nearcore 2.13.3 (protocol 86); consensus requires every node binary to apply identical protocol-86 rules.
Anchors are the saved observed day-close blocks; weeks are the exact intervals between them.
RPC-derived evidence from one public archival endpoint; not an independent chain proof.
measured: exact anchor total supplies and weekly supply movements
epoch boundary heights, hashes and timestamps
active protocol version and max_inflation_rate at each anchor
protocol_derived_bounds: issuance lower bound from unsigned net header debit
issuance upper bound from the nearcore epoch-reward ceiling
net header debit range implied by those bounds

interpretation: Over the eight weeks, epoch-reward issuance lies between the exact supply movement and the protocol ceiling. The bounded net header debit is the net quantity that offsets issuance in the supply identity; it is not gross burn, does not separate subsidies and is not execution spending.
